reason: I already carry a reusable bottle and only really need a filter for hotel water a few times a year. Paying $63 for the bottle alone, or getting locked into a filter plan to make it $40, is too much on my budget for something I'd use that rarely.
objection: The cheap price only comes with a subscription, and I know I'll forget to cancel it and keep paying for filters I don't use between trips.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle-only price around $35 with free shipping, plus filters I can buy one at a time when I need them, no plan.
